newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crudes drift lower, lack of deals.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crudes drift lower, lack of deals.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crudes drifted lower midday Thursday, tracking benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI), with no deals reported as traders assessed their needs for February.
Trade has fallen this week, players said, as traders waited to see how quickly loadings of oil tankers would resume in Alaska a slowdown over the weekend.
Tankers were held up or partially loaded after a water treatment plant closed over the weekend at Alaska's Valdez port, officials said earlier.
Traders said the delays would not impact prices.
